function: Excluded for system: the over-the-air federated distillation (area 7) runs on a link with a single-antenna parameter server and single-antenna devices and no RIS (p. 2)
notes: Reason code system. p. 2: "consisting of a single-antenna PS and M single-antenna WDs"; the channel is a scalar coefficient per device (p. 3, Eq. 10), and no RIS, MIMO, or beamforming appears anywhere in the paper. By function it is area 7: devices send noise-perturbed class-wise soft predictions that superpose over the multiple-access channel (p. 1-2). The transceiver power control and the number of rounds are closed-form (p. 4), and the learned element is the CNN trained across devices on MNIST (p. 5), so under the federated-learning-over-the-air clause it passes no_learning; if the reviewer reads federated distillation as outside that clause, no_learning would apply first. PDF is the arXiv preprint 2508.06557v1 (6 Aug 2025), titled Communication-Learning Co-Design for Differentially Private Over-the-Air Federated Distillation; the file does not print the DOI, so the DOI-to-title match cannot be checked from it.
